e.title: insurance-dynamics
e.summary: 动态定价模型（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.4）：GAS score-driven 滤波器 + 贝叶斯变点检测
e.summary_en: Dynamic pricing models (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.4): GAS score-driven filters + Bayesian change-point detection
e.summary_hk: 動態定價模型（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.4）：GAS score-driven 濾波器 + 貝葉斯變點檢測
e.body: insurance-dynamics（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.4）做动态保险定价：GAS（广义自回归得分）score-driven 滤波器——模型参数随时间自适应更新；贝叶斯变点检测——市场结构突变识别。对 RIAA：费率需要随环境变化——传统定价是静态的，动态定价让模型参数自适应（通胀冲击、竞争变化）；与 [[insurance-gas]]（GAS 专项）、[[insurance-changepoint]]（变点检测）、[[insurance-trend]] 配套构成时间维度家族；「模型何时该重估」是模型风险管理（[[insurance-monitoring]]）的核心问题。
e.body_en: insurance-dynamics (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.4) does dynamic insurance pricing: GAS (generalised autoregressive score) score-driven filters — model parameters adapt over time; Bayesian change-point detection — identifying structural market breaks. For RIAA: rates need to adapt to the environment — classical pricing is static, dynamic pricing lets parameters self-adapt (inflation shocks, competitive shifts); with [[insurance-gas]] (GAS specialist), [[insurance-changepoint]] (change-point detection) and [[insurance-trend]] it forms the time-dimension family; 'when should the model be re-estimated' is core to model risk management ([[insurance-monitoring]]).
e.body_hk: insurance-dynamics（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.4）做動態保險定價：GAS（廣義自迴歸得分）score-driven 濾波器——模型參數隨時間自適應更新；貝葉斯變點檢測——市場結構突變識別。對 RIAA：費率需要隨環境變化——傳統定價是靜態的，動態定價讓模型參數自適應（通脹衝擊、競爭變化）；與 [[insurance-gas]]（GAS 專項）、[[insurance-changepoint]]（變點檢測）、[[insurance-trend]] 配套構成時間維度家族；「模型何時該重估」是模型風險管理（[[insurance-monitoring]]）的核心問題。
